name: Camp Sunrise – Norwalk
description_short: A YMCA day camp for children entering Kindergarten through 8th grade, based at Jefferson Elementary School in Norwalk, running Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–3:00 PM. On Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays campers go to the Wilton YMCA for swimming, the ropes course, archery, sports and other activities.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming and swim lessons, plus inflatables in the pond, take place at the Wilton YMCA on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays.

refund_policy_summary: A $75 deposit per week is due at registration and balances are due May 4. Weeks dropped before March 15 are refunded less $50 per week; between March 15 and May 3 the Y keeps $100 per week and puts the rest on account as credit. From May 4 nothing is refunded or credited. Switching weeks is free before March 15 and $25 after, if space allows.
special_needs_notes: The 2027 pricing sheet lists Special Needs Care at $580 a week early bird or $645 regular.
